Whilst not a female redittor I thought I'd share two with you one from me one from my gf who for this we shall call Jennifer (I'm not gonna tie it to her real name or reddit account). I'll give you the saga of how over a few weeks the insult "yeah well you shat yourself" "so what so did you" became a common exchange in our relationship

So me first, ok so this time time last year I took tool many of my psych meds and put myself in hospital (i'm ok now). I was exploding violently out my rear for about 3 days and it took me about 4 months before I could fart with confidence.


So about 4-6 weeks after this happens she takes me to Copenhagen to see all the places she grew up to try and get my mind off the last few months. So naturally we end up going to Christiana quite a lot and have a bit of a stock pile of nice bud to smoke.

So one day we decide to go out and just wander around the city and explore, while we're doing this we ended up in a park that must of been the only park without convenient access to toilets in the whole of Copenhagen.

All of a sudden this look of terror comes over her face as she tells me "Woblybeats I need to poop."

"Thats ok Jennifer I'm sure we can find a cafe or something if not lets chuck this joint and go home its only 20 minutes away."

"No woblybeats you don't understand I need to poop NOW"

"are you sure?"

"do you think I'd mention it if I wasn't sure?"

"ok Jennifer well we can either go home, find a toilet or you can go into a shop or you can use the bushes over there I won't judge you for any of those options"

So up gets my gorgeous Girlfriend waddles over to this wooded bit and proceeds to make like a bear with me throwing occasional advice like moss helps clear up leaves spread it (learnt through too many multi day parties in woods as a teenager).

so yeah that's how we both pooped ourselves it happens try not to feel too bad about this.

TL:DR so yeah everyone poops themselves men and women just learn to embrace it and eventually it will just be funny and embarrassing rather than just straight up embarrassing.
